# gtm_containers (Data Source)

Lists all Containers that belongs to a GTM Account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent` (String) GTM Account's API relative path.

### Optional

- `all_pages` (Boolean) Follow next_page_token until every page has been retrieved. Defaults to true.
- `page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

### Read-Only

- `container_json` (String, Sensitive) All Containers of a GTM Account.
- `next_page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.
